english: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
text: stood to attention and saluted 是一套符合军人身份的反应，前后动作使他的伪装在情节中继续成立。to attention 表示立正状态，不是“为了引起注意”；表达后者要用 to attract attention。
